landManager: Olympic National Forest (Duckabush Trailhead and first ~6 trail miles), transitioning to Olympic National Park / Daniel J. Evans Wilderness at the park boundary near mile 6.2.
storedPass: Duckabush Trailhead (USFS) day-use parking: $5/vehicle/day or $30 annual pass — Northwest Forest Pass, Interagency, or Digital Pass accepted; no separate NPS entrance fee is charged at this backcountry-only access point.

Northwest Forest Pass, Interagency Pass or Scan & Pay at the Duckabush Trailhead — $5 per vehicle per day or $30 annual. The trailhead is on Olympic National Forest land, so no Olympic National Park entrance fee is charged to park there.
drive: From Quilcene, drive south on US-101 about 15 miles to the Duckabush Recreation Area; turn west onto Duckabush River Road/FS Rd 2510 for 6 miles, then follow FS Rd 2510-060 to the Duckabush Trailhead.

drive: Drive Highway 542 to the Upper Mt. Baker Ski Area lot. The highway beyond the ski area was gated for the winter season on October 25, 2026, so this lot is as far as vehicles can go until the gate reopens.

landManager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)
storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass required at Mountain Loop Highway trailheads — $5/day or $30/year.
drive: From the Mountain Loop Highway near milepost 7, turn onto Tupso Pass Road (Forest Road 41). The road is washed out about 4.8 miles in and closed to vehicles beyond, so the trailhead at its end is reached only on foot or by bike. From September 29 through December 31, 2026 the road is also closed to all traffic from the Forest Road 4110 junction for timber operations.

landManager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Mt. Baker Ranger District) — Noisy-Diobsud Wilderness, with some upper routes crossing into North Cascades National Park
storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass required at most trailheads — $30/year or $5/day.
drive: From SR 20 near milepost 82, turn north onto Baker Lake Road (Forest Road 11) and go about 14 miles, turn right onto Baker Dam Road and cross Upper Baker Dam, then turn left onto FR 1107 and follow it about 8.9 miles to the Anderson and Watson Lakes junction and 1.1 miles more to the trailhead. A washout has closed FR 1107 to vehicles since July 2026.

drive: From Highway 20 in Winthrop, turn north on West Chewuch Road, go straight at the junction with East Chewuch Road after about 7 miles, continue about 2.5 miles as the road becomes Forest Road 51, then turn left onto Forest Road 5130 (Eightmile Road) and follow it for about 12 miles until you reach the pullout for the trailhead, on the right.
